items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: Irving Goodman and Jimmy Maxwell was on trumpet... I'm talking as if it was yesterday my dear friend. It was the Hotel New Yorker on 34th Street.

ctx.x: How many is that? Count with me. Harry, Irving, Freddy, Joe, Jerry, two sisters, Ida and Ethel, that’s seven. I don’t think I missed any. Irving played trumpet. Freddy played a little trumpet but not that good. He wound up being Benny Goodman’s manager. Irving Goodman was with Benny Goodman’s band, I’ll never forget, at the Hotel New Yorker. Mel Powell was the pianist at that time. And I was there the night they introduced Peggy Lee to sing a song called “Why Don’t You Do Right?” And that song took off like…
Those bands worked awful hard, didn’t they, hour wise.
